verdict.rationale: Gusto's quickstart docs describe a dedicated Demo environment where developers can create multiple test applications. It runs against a separate base URL (api.gusto-demo.com), which gives testing a home apart from production. Isolation from production data is implied by the separate environment rather than spelled out, and the evidence comes from a single first-party doc. Missing for 10: explicit statement that demo data is isolated from production, details on test-data seeding or reset, evidence of agent/MCP tooling pointed at the demo environment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can create multiple applications for testing in our Demo environment on the [Gusto Developer Portal](https://dev.gusto.com/).
The demo environment runs against a separate base URL, https://api.gusto-demo.com
